title: A four-shell, 136-metal 3d-4f heterometallic cluster approximating a rectangular parallelepiped

synthesis.procedure: Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, La(NO3)3·6H2O and iminodiacetic acid were dissolved in 15 mL deionized water. The solution was stirred at about 80 °C while freshly prepared aqueous NaOH was added dropwise until incipient but permanent precipitation. The mixture was refluxed for 5 h, filtered while hot, and the filtrate was evaporated under ambient conditions to obtain blue block-shaped crystals.

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide solution
reagents.amount: 1.0 M aqueous solution; volume not reported

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered while hot; filtrate evaporated under ambient conditions to give blue block-shaped crystals.

properties.summary: Susceptibility data suggest weak ferromagnetic interactions between Ni(II) ions. The low-temperature decrease in χMT was attributed to possible inter-cluster antiferromagnetic interactions; the cluster is essentially paramagnetic over the fitted higher-temperature range.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete La60Ni76 core approximates a rectangular parallelepiped and contains four nested metal shells: inner Ni8, La20Ni4, La40, and outer Ni64. Triply bridging hydroxo groups connect adjacent shells, while iminodiacetate ligands chelate and bridge metals. The reported cationic cluster dimensions are approximately 23 × 23 × 31 Å.
